title: Smoke with real eidolon (mock only): every feature in the page
what:
Setup:
- Build into /tmp/minerva-x0-target. Perch on 127.0.0.1:48022 under `env -i` with temp HOME and XDG_CONFIG/DATA/STATE/CACHE/RUNTIME, PATH and LANG only.
- No provider env keys or files; member config default_model mock; swarm off.
- Before and after: a manifest of the real ~/.config/eidolon and ~/Minerva (path, size, mtime, sha256; contents never printed), with the real home taken from getent passwd.
- Temp config plugins:
  - jev and fake-browser copies with ports rewritten to 48091 (stub_service, whose /health says decisions_log off since P1) and token_file paths absolute under the temp HOME
  - plugins/term and plugins/mail copies, with token and url files under the temp HOME, granted
  - a test-only user tool term_probe.rn in the temp tools_dir with manifest name `grep` (the mock's 2nd scripted call, catalog.rs:877-881). Through eidolon::tool_call it runs:
    - term_whoami, then term_open
    - term_send 'echo probe' + enter
    - term_send of an ssh line, then read with a wait, then list
    - mail_send to self
  - The ssh line is 'ssh -F /dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o IdentityFile=/dev/null -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PasswordAuthentication=no -o KbdInteractiveAuthentication=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=3 -p 48029 127.0.0.1 true'. Port 48029 is asserted closed first, so it ends in 'Connection refused' and never reaches your sshd. OpenSSH reads ~/.ssh from the passwd home, not $HOME, so the flags, not the temp HOME, keep your keys and config out.
- aoide 0.0.26 with temp AOIDE_ROOT, AOIDE_AUDIT_LOG, AOIDE_DAEMON_SOCKET and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR.
- fake_minerva in installed mode.
- hello.model == mock checked before EVERY send.
Walk (orchestrator, browser pane, one check at a time):
- pass 1 rows:
  - chats: new chat (inbox and project); send, queue, approve and deny; fork latest and from a reply; rename, pin, archive, trash, restore
  - files and models: files tab, tree, image viewer; model menu (a non-mock model fails closed: no credentials exist)
  - the three modes; a saved chat read-only, then continue
  - the loaded (with the guard line), diff, run, graph and mesh tabs
  - runs: start, park, answer, cancel, abandon, can't-resume; a start refused while a second stub /health reports a log path
- terminals: open, type, pop out, back, take over, reload repaint
- `:term` (web), `:window term` (native launcher logged), `:note`
- the agent terminal through the probe:
  - yolo (runs), auto (term_send asks), manual (all ask)
  - with ⌨ closed, the badge, the toast and the rail switch
- guard rows by `eidolon policy` on the X0 config:
  - denied in yolo with their sentences: 'aoide mail send x', 'ssh h', 'minerva keys add k.pub'
  - a vouched browser verb still silent in auto
- notes: create, autosave, conflict, rename, trash and restore
- send to this machine -> card -> composer, with no say; hand-off
- agent mail: 403 when off, 202 when on, the sent origin line, the card's minerva-agent line
- allow-for-chat in manual: allow; auto-answer if the mock repeats; revoke; a mode switch clears
- install: notice, keys inspect and add with an arm
Also record:
- that no workflow appears in /hub/sessions
- that `mail outbox --json` changes no state mtimes
- whether the mock repeats its script on a 2nd send
Output: a pass/fail table with screenshots in scratch. Fixes go back to the slice that owns the file.
tests: This is the end-to-end check itself.
live_check:
Pass means:
- every row passes and the console is clean
- there is no ModelSpend in any run or chat log
- no request leaves loopback, and the ssh probe's connect is refused on 48029
- the ~/.config/eidolon and ~/Minerva manifests are identical
risk:
- If tool_call from a user tool cannot reach plugin tools, the agent rows fall back to T2's fake-door proof and say so.
- If the mock does not repeat its script, allow auto-answer is proven by A1b's fake only.
- The ssh probe proves only the live feed of an ssh command; no ssh session is made.
